help.title: How to use Brisa
help.intro: Brisa installs and updates native PC ports (SoH, 2Ship2Harkinian, Dusklight, TMC, …) directly from your ROMs, and even adds them to Steam as non-Steam games.

help.steps.title: Add your ROMs
help.steps.text: In the ROMs tab, drop your files anywhere in the window or click "＋ Add ROMs". They will be copied to Brisa's ROMs folder.

help.steps.title: Check the matches
help.steps.text: Each ROM shows a green chip for every compatible port (one per port, or per requirement in multi-ROM ports). If a ROM matches nothing, it shows a red "No matches" chip.

help.steps.title: Install a port
help.steps.text: Go to the Available ports tab, make sure the ROM requirement is green (✓), and click "Install". If the ROM is missing you can still install, but the port won't run until you add it.

help.steps.title: Play and update
help.steps.text: Click "Play" to launch the port. When an update is available you'll see an orange chip (⬆ 1.2.3 → 1.4.0): click "Update" or "Update and play".

help.steps.title: Manage mods
help.steps.text: "＋ Add mods" opens the port's mods folder. Mods appear as chips in the card: click ＋ to enable one or ✕ to disable it. "Open mods" shows the full list.

help.steps.title: Add ports to Steam
help.steps.text: Each installed port gets a launcher (.sh / .cmd) in Brisa's launchers folder. Add those files to Steam as non-Steam games; they stay up to date automatically.

help.steps.title: Open files
help.steps.text: "Open files" shows the installed port's folder in your file manager. Clicking the port's icon opens its repository in your browser.

help.legal: ⚠ ROMs must be obtained legally: only use copies of games you own.
